content: धीर {%a.%} [धियं राति रा-क, धियमीरयति ईर-अण् वा <sab>उप˚ स˚</sab> <ls>Tv.</ls>] Brave, bold, courageous; धीरोद्धता गतिः <ls>U. 6. 19</ls>. .²2 Steady, steadfast, firm, durable, lasting, constant; निषेदुषीमासनबन्धधीरः <ls>R. 2. 6</ls>. .²3 Strong-minded, persevering, self-possessed, resolute, of firm resolve or purpose; धीरा हि तरन्त्यापदम् <ls>K. 175</ls>; विकारहेतौ सति विक्रियन्ते येषां न चेतांसि त एव धीराः <ls>Ku. 1. 59</ls>. .²4 Composed, calm, collected. .²5 Sedate, sober, grave, solemn; सागरधीरचेताः <ls>R. 18. 4</ls>. .²6 Strong, energetic. .²7 Wise, prudent, intelligent, sensible, learned, clever; तमेव धीरो विज्ञाय प्रज्ञां कुर्वीत ब्राह्मणः <ls>Bṛ. Up. 4. 4. 21</ls>. धृतेश्च धीरः सदृशीर्व्यधत्त सः <ls>R. 3. 10</ls>, <ls n="R.">5. 38</ls>, <ls n="R.">16. 74</ls>; <ls>U. 5. 31</ls>. .²8 Deep, grave, loud, hollow (as sound); स्वरेण धीरेण निवर्तयन्निव <ls>R. 3. 43</ls>, <ls n="R. 3.">59</ls>; <ls>U. 6. 17</ls>. .²9 Well-conducted, well-behaved. .²10 Gentle, soft, agreeable, pleasing (as a breeze); धीरसमीरे यमुनातीरे वसति वने वनमाली <ls>Gīt. 5</ls>. .²11 Lazy, dull. .²12 Daring. .²13 Headstrong. .{@-रः@} .²1 The ocean. .²2 An epithet of Buddha. .²3 The thinking principle, the soul (चिदात्मन्). .²4 An epithet of king Bali. .{@-रम्@} Saffron. .{@-रम्@} --{%ind.%} Boldly, firmly, steadfastly, steadily; धीरं विलोकयति <ls>Bh. 2. 31</ls>; <ls>Amaru. 13</ls>.
